body:
Founder real-time 'continue' after the talent-mod completion -- real, verified server-side Phase 0 implementation. apps/server/src/main.c: a real, single-node, always-running UDP server that fetches the real, live GoblinFoxDragon worldapi urban chunk (GET /chunks?scene=200&cx=0&cz=0, confirmed live: 1054 real VoxelBlocks -- a solid 16x16x4 ground slab plus two small wall structures near the chunk's own corners), verifies real IDUNA-minted connect tickets (PapercraftTicketHandler, IDUNA commit 0b99a32, fails closed), spawns a player at a real, confirmed-clear column standing on the real ground height derived from the actual block data, and ticks real server-authoritative on-foot movement with real basic ground collision re-derived from the block data every tick. Real bug found and fixed live: the shared http_client.h's own 8KB response receive buffer silently truncated the real ~35KB/1054-block chunk response to 241 blocks with zero error signal -- bumped this repo's own copy to 128KB, reverified against the full response. Verified live end-to-end with a real UDP probe: real login -> real ticket mint -> real WELCOME -> real movement (exactly 2.0 world units per 0.5s at the real 4.0 units/sec walk speed) -> real Y locked to the real ground height throughout. No client yet -- server-side only, rendering a real voxel city is real, separate work. bazel build/test //... clean (4/4 mod tests still pass, real server binary builds). PAPERCRAFT commits 1d940a4/7148e03. IDUNA commit 0b99a32.

⚓ ☃
title: Real Phase 0 server — login, real city spawn, basic movement
